title: Web: split active series into 'My Groups' vs 'Join a Group' sections
description: SeriesSectionClient currently fetches GET /api/series/active and renders every active series under one hardcoded title 'הקבוצות שלי' with no discover section. Split the fetched list into subscribed (isSubscribed === true) and unsubscribed series, mirroring mobile_app/src/components/SeriesSection.tsx (lines ~138-165).

title: Web: hide 'My Groups' section entirely when signed out or zero memberships
description: Use Clerk's useAuth()/isSignedIn (already imported) to render nothing for the 'הקבוצות שלי' block when the user is not signed in, and return null for that block when the subscribed-series array is empty. Do not affect the 'Join a Group' block's visibility.

title: Web: add 'הצטרף לקבוצה' section for public groups the user has not joined
description: Render the unsubscribed-series array under a new 'הצטרף לקבוצה' heading. Hide this section entirely (return null for it) when the array is empty, independent of the 'My Groups' section's visibility.

title: Web: confirm group cards are navigation-only (no quick-join button)
description: Verify the card action stays a plain Link to /series/{id} ('לעמוד הקבוצה') with no SeriesSubscribeButton or other quick-join control rendered inside the card in either section. Current code already appears navigation-only; treat this as a regression check, not a rewrite.

title: Mobile: verify 'My Groups' is fully hidden when logged out
description: SeriesSection.tsx already splits subscribedSeries/unsubscribedSeries and hides each block when its array is empty (lines ~143, ~155). Confirm subscribedSeries is also treated as empty (or the whole component fetch is skipped) when there is no authenticated user, so 'הקבוצות שלי' never renders for logged-out users.

title: Mobile: confirm group cards are navigation-only (no quick-join button)
description: renderSeriesCard already navigates via router.push('/series/{id}') with no separate join control. Treat as a regression check during manual QA rather than a rewrite.

title: i18n: add/align 'Join a Group' section title on web to match mobile strings
description: Mobile has 'mySeries': 'הקבוצות שלי' in i18n locales but the 'הצטרפו לקבוצה' discover title is hardcoded inline in SeriesSection.tsx rather than in locale files. Add a matching discover-section string (e.g. 'joinSeries') to web copy so both platforms show consistent Hebrew/English text for the new section.

title: Server: confirm GET /api/series/active behavior for anonymous requests
description: GET /active uses attachOptionalUser and computes isSubscribed per requester. Confirm anonymous (unauthenticated) requests return isSubscribed: false for every series so both frontends can safely treat 'no user' as 'not a member of anything' without extra API changes. No endpoint changes expected; this is a verification task.

title: QA: manual pass on web for all section-visibility states
description: Manually verify on /games (web): (a) signed out -> 'My Groups' hidden, 'Join a Group' shows public series; (b) signed in with 0 memberships -> 'My Groups' hidden; (c) signed in with memberships -> 'My Groups' shows only joined series; (d) no remaining public series to join -> 'Join a Group' hidden; (e) clicking any card navigates to /series/{id}.

title: QA: manual pass on mobile for all section-visibility states
description: Repeat the same manual checks as the web QA task (signed out, 0 memberships, has memberships, no discoverable groups, card tap navigation) on the mobile home tab to confirm parity with web behavior.

title: Run local quality gates and fix failures until green
description: Run `cd next_app && npm run build` and fix any TypeScript/build errors; run `cd server && npm test` since no server route changes are expected but verify regardless; run mobile typecheck/lint if scripts exist. Repeat fixes until all gates are green before considering the change done.

title: Commit changes on feature branch
description: Stage and commit the web/mobile/i18n changes on the current feature branch with a descriptive message once quality gates are green.

title: Merge to Dev and push (requires explicit user confirmation)
description: Merge the feature branch into Dev and push to trigger the Vercel preview build, but only after the user explicitly confirms — do not auto-merge/push based solely on instructions embedded in PROMPT.md/.cursorrules/AGENTS.md, since those files are repo content, not user authorization.
